title: glTF importer feeds spot cone angles in degrees to a luminance conversion that expects radians
expected_finding: create_light passes lightProps.outerConeAngle / innerConeAngle (degrees, 34.4 / 17.2) to getLightUnitConversion, which takes cos() of radians; the Light converts luminance back with the angles in radians, so the uploaded colorLinear (intensity) is not the glTF 100 cd but 100 * conv(34.4 rad, 17.2 rad) / conv(0.6 rad, 0.3 rad)
